name: Kidou Senshi Gundam
source:
Gundam Daichi ni Tatsu!! (Gundam stands on the ground!!) is also the name for the very first episode of the anime. It is based on the first 3 episodes of the anime series. The game begins with Amuro exploring the colony, and eventually finds himself onboard the Gundam to defend against the Zeon attack. It starts out as a regular text parser adventure, but in the final part there is a shooting segment where the player goes up against a couple of Zaku mechs.

[From [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/gundam/gundam1.html]pixelmenu[/url]]
